inspection_scope: zip file list; first line (header) of every CSV/XLSX; metadata/*.json|txt; in-zip README.md; code/logs/*.log. No data row of any file containing a target column was printed or loaded.
finding_that_drives_the_binding: data/formulations.csv (the cleaned table) has columns ESM,HSPC,CHOL,PEG,TFR,FRR,AQUEOUS,SIZE,PDI and NO laboratory field: the authors' slicer log shows it is the concatenation of initial_formulations_raw (251 Micromixer rows, laboratory A) and new_formulations_raw (57 Micromixer rows, laboratory B) after dropping ID/ML/CHIP/OUTPUT. Laboratory identity therefore lives in the raw_data files, which become the bound data files.

sealed_secondary.laboratory: A (operator B, equipment A) — operator shift, outside the frozen protocol's primary estimand; sealed anyway so a future amendment can use it blind

not_used.data_extensions/*: synthetic augmentation (SMOTE / Gaussian noise) — never used
not_used.raw_data/*.xlsx: source spreadsheets; the authors' checker (code/raw_data_checker.py) produced the CSVs with standardised names and out-of-bounds values set to NaN; digests recorded, CSVs used

laboratory_rule.sealed_primary_rows: all rows of new_formulations_raw.csv with CHIP == 'Micromixer'
laboratory_rule.development_rows: all rows of initial_formulations_raw.csv with CHIP == 'Micromixer'

dropped_input_columns.ML: main lipid, deterministic function of ESM/HSPC (mutually exclusive per authors' log) — excluded to avoid a redundant categorical

cluster_column.name: ID
cluster_column.rule: if IDs are unique within a file, clusters degenerate to rows; the custodian reports n_rows and n_unique_ids only

stratum_column.name: AQUEOUS
stratum_column.note: candidate-level strata inside the sealed set require >= 2 levels with >= 4 rows each

quarantine_rules: CHIP != 'Micromixer' (authors report no liposome formation on Droplet chips)
any required input (ESM, HSPC, CHOL, PEG, TFR, FRR, AQUEOUS) missing or non-finite

development rows with missing SIZE are dropped from development and counted; sealed rows keep their inputs regardless, missing sealed labels are handled only by the reveal program (count reported after reveal)

deviations_from_protocol_text.text: Protocol §3 expected the cleaned 304-row file in data/; it carries no laboratory field, so the bound data files are the authors' checker-processed raw CSVs. Development/sealed membership is by file identity, which is stronger (not inferred from values).
README states 304 cleaned rows while the authors' slicer log reports 308; the custodian reports its own counts and does not reconcile the discrepancy.
